name: MZEN (Multi-zoom Enhanced NeRF)
definition: A framework for 3-D reconstruction with unknown camera poses that explicitly models optical zoom as a learnable intrinsic parameter and uses cross-zoom pose registration to align non-overlapping zoomed-in and zoomed-out views, enabling stable training across multiple zoom levels without high-resolution images or external pose initialization.
summary: MZEN is a 3-D reconstruction framework that explicitly models optical zoom as a learnable parameter to resolve geometric inconsistencies in pose-free NeRFs without relying on high-resolution pyramids.
